title: Ecommerce Platform Market Share Scraper input

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: platform = headline stats for a platform (live stores, quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year growth). growth = the full quarterly store-count series back to 2019. breakdown = stores by country, category, app, technology, theme, shipping carrier and more. migration = how many stores switched to and from the platform. stores = the top and newest stores published in the report. reference = every platform report available.
enumTitles: platform - headline stats and growth rates
breakdown - stores by country, app, technology ...
migration - stores switching in and out
stores - top and newest stores on the platform

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: A single platform slug, e.g. shopify, woocommerce, bigcommerce, wix, squarespace, magento. A full report URL works too.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Several platforms to compare in one run. Run mode 'reference' first to see all 110 available slugs.

allPlatforms.title: All platforms
allPlatforms.description: Ignore the list above and process every platform report published (about 110). Useful for a full market snapshot in one run.

dimension.title: Dimension (breakdown mode)
dimension.description: Limit the breakdown to one dimension.

dimensions.title: Dimensions (breakdown mode)
dimensions.description: Several dimensions at once. Leave empty for all of them.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum records per run. A full breakdown of one platform is roughly 150 rows.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many platform reports to fetch in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The reports answered every request without a proxy.
